title: Compatibility of the explicit restricted cone comparison with colimit legs
statement: For any preordered I, diagram D : Iᵒᵖ → Over S, cone c, coefficients F, coefficient diagram H on the cone point with a colimit, object isomorphisms eH identifying H_i with the inverse images of F_i, and etale U over S, the inverse of the explicit cone comparison [def-sbc-restricted-affine-single-maps] followed by the leg of the concrete restricted colimit cocone [def-sbc-restricted-affine-coefficient-construction] equals mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor.hom followed by singleFunctor.map of rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient for the original cone leg, with coefficient eH_i.inv followed by colimit.iota_i [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology]. No coefficient transitions, transition coherence, directedness, nonemptiness, or geometric limit are assumed.

source.place: Tag 09Z1 proof, restriction to an affine etale object; Tag 0EZM coefficient complexes; Tag 03CB canonical inverse-image composition comparisons

proof.text: Expand the inverse of the explicit cone isomorphism and the mapped cocone leg. The inverse factors are the single comparison, the inverse composition comparison for q and r_i, the composition comparison for r and c_i, and the restricted eH inverse. Combine the latter with the restricted colimit injection by functoriality. These are exactly the defining factors of rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient. The pullback projection identity makes the two composite inverse images identical, and proof irrelevance identifies the witnesses of that equality.
